routing_rules: Consumer repo workflow-sync or Workflows-maintenance tasks belong in stranske/Workflows unless the issue directly implements behavior required by the consumer repo design.
Repos marked deeper-review must receive a real design-vs-implementation review before the automation accepts no-new-issues as a valid outcome.
Approved issue bodies must follow templates/consumer-repo/docs/AGENT_ISSUE_FORMAT.md before entering opener-lane automation. The body-writer pass enforces this.
INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE candidates from the body-writer pass MUST NOT be uploaded; route them to deeper-review.
